steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Control board and inlet valve are not grounded during service.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Execute service after unplugging the power supply unit.

steps.title: Door fully closed
steps.body: Close door firmly. Check door sensor unit not loose.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Close door firmly. Check door sensor unit not loose.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Secure door sensor harness and latch.

steps.title: Door switch continuity
steps.body: Disconnect power. Door switch 125 V 10 A — measure OFF: open circuit; ON (door closed): closed circuit per §4-6.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Door switch 125 V 10 A — measure OFF: open circuit; ON (door closed): closed circuit per §4-6.

steps.title: Switch toggles correctly?
steps.body: Resistance/continuity changes when door latched vs open?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance/continuity changes when door latched vs open?

steps.title: Secure door assembly
steps.oemOutcome: Tighten door sensor and verify latch.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace door switch when incorrect state (dF).
